Subject: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT mapping for 2026 commitment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is aligned and legal has approved a 12-month committed spend. Finance here needs to lock the invoicing triggers and confirm which Redwood entity we should invoice for VAT purposes so we can set up our AP workflow.

High-level asks from our side: 
- A proposed invoice trigger calendar (dates and payment windows) for the 12-month prepay so our treasury can reserve liquidity.
- Confirmation of the invoiced legal entity (and VAT ID) for EU & UK purchases — ClearStream requires VAT-exempt vs VAT-charged treatment depending on the vendor entity.
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can sync procurement milestones with your billing ops.

We can provide PO/contract references once you confirm the entity and the first invoice date.

Attaching a spreadsheet with our VAT breakout by country for reference.

Cheers,
Sofia Rinaldi
Head of Finance Operations
ClearStream AI

Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT mapping for 2026 commitment

Hi Sofia — great to hear this is moving forward. I’ve sketched an initial cadence and a short MAP below and attached a working MAP XLSX that we can update together.

Proposed invoice trigger calendar (first pass):
- Invoice 1: 2026-07-01 — initial prepay invoice (covers Jul–Sep tranche) — due net 30
- Invoice 2: 2026-10-01 — quarterly top-up (covers Oct–Dec) — due net 30
- Invoice 3: 2027-01-01 — final quarterly settlement (covers Jan–Mar) — due net 30

Drawdown windows (how ClearStream will consume credits):
- Continuous consumption; finance can request monthly balance reports.
- We support manual drawdown notifications for milestone-triggered consumption if you prefer staged releases.

VAT / entity mapping: we need to confirm whether ClearStream should be invoiced by Redwood Inference, Inc. (US, no VAT) or Redwood Inference Ltd. (EU VAT ID available). For UK/EU purchases, if you are VAT-registered we typically issue invoices from Redwood Inference Ltd. with VAT as applicable; otherwise we issue without VAT and provide supplier VAT documentation.

Actions I propose (MAP) — I’ve added these to the attached MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx: 
1) Redwood confirms invoicing entity + VAT ID for EU/UK (K. Park) — target 2026-06-03
2) ClearStream confirms preferred invoice cadence and PO references (S. Rinaldi) — target 2026-06-04
3) Finance handoff: provide bank remit + W-9/W-8 as needed (M. Cole / Redwood Finance) — target 2026-06-07

I’ll loop Marissa from Finance to finalize banking and sample invoice layout.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Annual prepay invoicing cadence + VAT mapping for 2026 commitment

Thanks — a few operational clarifications from the billing side so the MAP is actionable: 

1) Invoice numbering & ledger: our invoices will reference the deal id (CLSTR-2026-06-01) in the invoice ID for straight-through processing. If you need a separate PO number to post the invoice, please confirm the exact PO string we should include.

2) Currency & FX: invoices will be issued in USD unless you request EUR/GBP invoicing. If you choose EUR/GBP, we need to confirm which Redwood entity (Ltd vs Inc) will be on the invoice to ensure correct VAT treatment.

3) Escrow / holdback: if you want retention (e.g., 10% held until Q4 usage verification), confirm now so we can reflect in the invoice amounts and the drawdown credit ledger.

4) Evidence for VAT exemption: for EU reverse-charge, we require ClearStream’s VAT registration number and billing address. For non-EU entities, we will provide supplier VAT docs or W-9/W-8 as needed.

Operational ask: Sofia — can you share a sample PO string and confirm whether ClearStream prefers a quarterly invoice or a single upfront annual invoice with monthly consumption reporting?

Karthik
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
